'''Custard creams''' are a variety of [[Cookbook:Sandwich Cookie|sandwich cookie]] (US) or biscuit (UK).
==Ingredients==
*200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (7.1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|plain flour]], plus extra for dusting
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|bicarbonate of soda]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*80 g (2.8 oz / ⅔ stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*125 g (4.4 oz / ⅝ cup) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
*1 standard (50 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*180 g (6.3 oz / ¾ cup) thick [[Cookbook:Custard|custard]], such as [[Cookbook:Pastry Cream|pastry cream]]
==Procedure==
#Combine the flour, bicarbonate of soda, and salt in a bowl.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter, sugar and vanilla in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the egg.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, and bring together until a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] forms.
#[[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
#Shape the dough into a flat disc. Cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|clingfilm]] and chill for 30 minutes.
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F}}.
#Line 2 [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking trays]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]].
#[[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] the dough to {{Convert|5|mm|in|abbr=on}} thick.
#Cut out into 24 circles with a [[Cookbook:Cookie Cutter|cookie cutter]].
#Transfer the biscuits to the prepared baking trays.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10–12 minutes until well-cooked.
#Place the biscuits on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and leave to cool completely.
#Spoon 1 tablespoon of custard onto one biscuit. Sandwich it together with another biscuit.
#Repeat the biscuit assembly, using remaining biscuits and custard.
#Enjoy!
==Notes, tips, and variations==
*If the dough is too wet, mix in 1 tablespoon of plain flour.
